items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I said, " Well, if you really do, then why don't you write a piece for the band? "

ctx.x: With any person, about anything. And I took the liberty and of course, he's a nice young man and I enjoyed being with him on a Dinah Shore different kind of television show, and one thing led to another and he said how much he appreciated the fact we had been doing his music, and I said, " Well, if you really do, then why don't you write a piece for the band?
